verdict.rationale: An inference API could plausibly accept MCP servers as tool sources, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only generic tool/function calling, where your own application defines and executes the functions. That is a developer building block, not a documented way to plug MCP servers into Cerebras Inference, and nothing in the pack mentions MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Tool calling, also known as tool use or function calling, lets a model request functions that your application defines.
